name: Longsword
description: Your standard, boring longsword.

name: Wooden Katana
description: Also called a bokken in Oniga, the land of the katana's origin. The more you know!

name: Wooden Longsword
description: Your standard, boring longsword, only this time, it's made out of wood.

name: Wooden Nelten
description: A heavy longsword that is iconic to Chaturanga's military division. Its destructive power is high. This one is made out of wood material.

name: Longsword (Enhanced)

specials.name: Enhanced Stats
specials.description: +3 STR

description: Your standard, boring longsword.

name: Swordfish Sword

specials.name: Water Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 50% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

description: Ya-Ha! A sword, made out of... a swordfish.

name: Wo-Dao

specials.name: Critical Bonus
specials.description: Increases Critical Chance

description: An extremely sharp sword originating from Oniga.

name: Bloody Fang

specials.name: Vampiric
specials.description: Vampiric (10%) (Basic attacks only)

description: A sword with a thirst for blood.

name: Endless Handkerchief

specials.name: Variable Range
specials.description: Attack range increases by 1 and basic attack damage increases by 3 for every empty Item Belt Slot.

specials.name: Spinning Strike
specials.description: Attack target is spun in a random direction.

description: Less of a weapon and more of a stage prop, your enemy will be left guessing just where this damn chain of handkerchiefs ends.

name: Eresh

specials.name: Darkness Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Impure Stroke
specials.description: The Duelist skill Eclair La'Croix is changed in the following ways: 1) Light damage becomes Dark. 2) Slash damage effect also inflicts Reduced Resistance (Dark) LV 30 for 3 rounds. (Reduced Resistance lowers the target's elemental resistance by LV.) 3) FP cost increased by 10.

description: A sword wrapped in darkness.

name: Fuuma

specials.name: Armor Reduction
specials.description: Reduces effectiveness of enemy Armor by 5.

specials.name: Wear Down
specials.description: When an enemy is damaged by weapons that reduce enemy Armor effectiveness, either by basic attacks or skills using them, a Wear Down status is applied for 3 rounds, or powered up. This status decreases the enemy's Armor by LV. (Max LV of 20, max duration of 3 rounds).

description: A mystical sword that is said to be powerful enough to chop through stones.

name: Moonblade

specials.name: Hit Bonus
specials.description: +5 Hit for 2 turns. Bonus becomes +10 instead on a critical hit. (At night, bonuses and duration are doubled.)

description: Crafted from silver and enchanted under the night sky.

name: Nelten
description: A heavy greatsword that is iconic to Chaturanga's military division. Its destructive power is high.

name: Crystal Blade

specials.name: Earth Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Earth bonus damage equal to 50% of your Earth ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Crystalline Armor
specials.description: Grants the attacker Crystalline Armor for 3 rounds. (+30% physical damage reduction, +20% magical damage reduction. Is removed when the bearer moves 2 or more tiles.)

description: Crystal Burst A cracked crystal blade, enchanted with Isespian magic.

name: Golgorth

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: On Critical Hit: Steals 10% of target's FP. (Max: 50 FP)

description: A fiend's blade that steals the essence of the living.

name: Needle

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Sub Type: Strings

specials.name: Unravel Strike
specials.description: Spin Up: 1M, 1 round CD. Wind up your weapon's thread, gaining Spun Weapon, which may confer different effects for certain weapons that can be spun up. Unravel Strike: 3M. Requires Spun Weapon. Basic attack that targets a 3 Size Diamond up to 3 Range away, but must be performed by a weapon that grants this skill. Afterwards, Spun Weapon ends. On Battle Start: Gain Spun Weapon. While you have Spun Weapon, weapon gains +5 Power and +5% Critical Damage. While you do not, weapon gains +5 Hit and +2 Attack Range.

description: A lightweight thrusting sword with a long metal thread used to enhance its power, or extend its reach.

name: Rapier of Resent

specials.name: Darkness Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Soul Burn
specials.description: If the user is at 50% or less HP, inflicts Soul Burn LV 20 for 5 rounds on the target. (Soul Burn inflicts Dark damage at the start of a round equal to LV.)

description: A sword which seems innocent enough, but harbors a dark spirit of resentment.

name: River Sword

specials.name: Water Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Water bonus damage equal to 50% of your Water ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Aqua Pulse
specials.description: When an enemy is damaged by a weapon that inflicts Water damage by skills or basic attacks, they become Drenched for 3 rounds. While Drenched, the target takes +25% damage from Lightning element attacks and cannot be set on fire.

description: Allows you to carve rivers in your enemies.

name: Spirit Sword

specials.name: Ghost Touch
specials.description: Weapon is treated as having the Ghost enchantment.

specials.name: Soul Strike
specials.description: Target loses 5% of their current FP. (10% if target has a spirit. 0% against spirits.)

description: This sword absorbs Focus from the wounds that it makes.

name: Bandit Sword

specials.name: Steal Bonus
specials.description: Increases Steal's success rate by 15%.

specials.name: Pilfer
specials.description: Targets one enemy within 1 Range. Messes with the target's inventory, preventing them from using items for 2 rounds.

description: Usually used by bandits, this sword helps you take things from others.

name: Dual-Blade

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Has two blade slots and a hilt slot.

description: A special type of sword with two blades, because two is better than one.

name: Engraved Katana

specials.name: Extra Scroll Slot
specials.description: Weapon gains an additional Scroll customization slot.

description: This katana, as the name implies, has a spell engraved in its metal.

name: Homura

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: When an enemy's Parry skill is triggered by this weapon's damage; deals 30 protection-ignoring Fire bonus damage to them. (1 round cooldown).

specials.name: Blazing Wind
specials.description: Creates an attackable Flare Tornado LV X (X = Fire ATK) at target location within 3 Range, which lasts for 5 rounds. The tornado damages anything it touches and creates Cinders around itself, and will move towards enemies at the start of a new round.

description: Soaked in the oil of those it's cut, this katana is waiting to burst at a moment's notice.

name: Cleaving Clarinet

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: +5 Wind ATK

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: When played (via a Song skill): Creates a whirlwind that draws all enemies within 3 Range 2 tiles towards you.

specials.name: Wind Risoluto
specials.description: Play the Cleaving Clarinet, creating an Air Shaft at your own location for 3 rounds. Afterwards, you attack all enemies within 1 Range with the Cleaving Clarinet.

description: It's more of an instrument shaped like a sword than a real sword, but the tip might be a little sharp, so watch your tongue.

name: Dynaxis

specials.name: Static Field
specials.description: When you perform a basic attack with this weapon, it creates a Static Field LV X (X = Dynaxis's Power) for 2 rounds at the target's location. (Static Fields deal Lightning bonus damage that ignores armor equal to LV to enemies when it is created, at the start of a new round, or when an enemy passes through it.)

specials.name: Thunder Strike
specials.description: Special Strike: Thunder Strike (Trigger Rate: 10% + 8% Bonus, Trigger CD: 2 rounds) - Triggers before an enemy is attacked. Increases the Critical for that attack by 15, changes the damage type to Lightning, and if the attack hits, deals 50 Lightning magic bonus damage to them.

description: An electrically overcharged greatsword. Anything it passes over will get charged up.

name: Excel Saber

specials.name: Charge Damage
specials.description: Consumes Weapon Charges, dealing 50% more damage per Charge Level.

specials.name: Charge Weapon
specials.description: Grants Skill: Charge Weapon (3 Momentum, 5 FP) - Rev your weapon and fill it with focus, increasing its Charge, to a maximum of level 3. When you hit with a weapon that can consume Weapon Charges, the damage you deal with that attack will increase by 50% per level. (Weapon Charges will expire after 5 rounds.)

specials.name: Elite Engine
specials.description: Shared Potential Skill. Charge Weapon FP cost is increased to 8 FP. Attacks do not use up all of your charges, instead the LV is reduced by 1, and the damage bonus is 35% (does not increase with charge amount like normal Excel attacks).

description: 3 Momentum, 5 FP The Excel line of weapons were developed in Chaturanga, where the ability to be defensive while increasing offensive capabilities was highly valued. By charging up the weapon, it can explosively spend the focus energy when it strikes an enemy, greatly increasing damage. However, the engine module makes it heavier than other weapons.

name: Sakabatou

specials.name: Flip Blade
specials.description: Grants Skill: Flip Blade (0M, 0 FP, 1 Round CD) - Turn your Sakabatou around, changing which side you're using. Grants or removes Flipped Blade (permanent duration). Flipped Blade: Your Sakabatou weapons deal Slash damage.

specials.name: Killing Is A Choice
specials.description: Sakabatou's Potential Skill. Sakabatou gains +5 Critical while it deals Slash damage, and you gain +5 Armor & Magic Armor while it deals Blunt damage. When you flip the Sakabatou to Slash damage, enemies within its attack range are inflicted with your Sakki (if the skill is equipped) and Slash Resist Down (LV 10, 1 round, 1 hit). 2 round CD if an enemy is affected.

specials.name: Nine Heads
specials.description: Special Strike - Nine Heads (Trigger Rate: 10% + 8% Bonus, Trigger CD: 3 Rounds) - Triggers before an enemy is attacked, and replaces the attack. An ultra fast strike hitting from 9 directions at once, dealing 125% Scaled Weapon Attack, and rendering it unavoidable and unparriable, but it deals no extra damage on a Critical Hit.

description: Flipped Blade: A reverse-blade sword, meaning the side where the edge normally would be is dull, and vice versa. It is somewhat less lethal with a dull edge, and can be flipped should you need to cut, but it requires a skilled hand to avoid hurting yourself.

name: Akuijin

specials.name: Darkness Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Darkness Resistance
specials.description: 10% Darkness Resistance

specials.name: Dark Moon
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Dark magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect melt, becoming Dark Water tiles in a 2 Range circle for 3 rounds.

description: A katana forged in a pit of evil, or so it's said.

name: Hakouhen Masterwork Katana

specials.name: Weapon Properties
specials.description: Always comes with the Sharp, Precise, Deadly, and Lightweight properties.

description: The Hakouhen style could best be described as a hawk swooping in for the kill; an aerial attack that is precise, powerful, and deadly. This is a sword made specifically for the followers of that school, and it works well as a lightweight weapon focused on attacking. However, because it's lightweight, the material is somewhat thin, making it easier to break than other weapons.

name: Kamiya

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Show Mercy's success rate increases by 15%. (Percentage of actual success rate; not additive.)

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Weapon suffers no penalties to damage, hit, or critical for being broken.

specials.name: Kamiya Guard
specials.description: 1+M, 0 FP, 2 Round CD A special self-defense technique. Consume all of your remaining Momentum and gain Swift Guard LV X (X = 8 x Momentum consumed), as you take a stance with the Kamiya. If you consume at least 4 Momentum this way, you also prepare the Kamiya Counter (until your next turn), a special retaliation strike that aims for the target's knees or other form of mobility. Kamiya Counter: Perform a counter attack (50% damage) when an enemy in 1 Range attacks you (except from behind), which will inflict Clumsy until the attacker's next turn if it hits. Doesn't stack with other counter attacks and takes priority over them.

description: Kamiya Counter: A wooden sword known as a 'bokken'. While it is often used for training purposes, there are some who practice non-lethal swordsmanship. In their hands, even a branch is a weapon.

name: Kouenjin

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: On Hit: Deals magic Fire bonus damage equal to 50% of your Fire ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: 10% Fire Resistance

specials.name: Crimson Lotus
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Fire magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect explode, knocking away field objects and dealing Fire magic damage equal to Hidden Cut's damage in a 3 Range circle around them.

description: A katana forged in the fires of the underworld, or so it's said.

name: Magical Star

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: Spelledge (This weapon can be used as a casting tool for spells.)

description: Become the star of the battlefield. Will not help you transform, however.

name: Raijin

specials.name: Lightning Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Lightning bonus damage equal to 50% of your Lightning ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Lightning Resistance
specials.description: 10% Lightning Resistance

specials.name: Kuuga
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Lightning magic damage, and can Lightning Critical.

description: A katana forged in the chaotic skies of a storm, or so it's said.

name: Sanjin

specials.name: Acid Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Acid bonus damage equal to 50% of your Acid ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Acid Resistance
specials.description: 10% Acid Resistance

specials.name: Mossy Grave
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Acid magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect melt, becoming LV 30 Poison Pool tiles in a 2 Range circle for 3 rounds.

description: A katana forged in the stomach of a monster, or so it's said.

name: Sea Hunter Sword

specials.name: Anti-Seafaring
specials.description: Inflicts Hunted LV14 for 3 rounds if the target is a seafaring monster.

specials.name: Coral Material
specials.description: Always comes made of Coral. (+1 Power, +3 Accuracy, +3 Critical, +1 Weight, +3 Water ATK.)

description: This sword was born from the sea, and as anyone who lives there knows, anything that lives in the sea is out to get everything else... that lives in the sea.

name: Yukijin

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: On Hit: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Passive
specials.description: 10% Ice Resistance

specials.name: Ice Lily
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Damage becomes Ice magic damage. Monsters who are defeated by this effect turn into Ice Points and create Ice Sheets in a 2 range diamond around themself, which last for 3 rounds each (The LV for the Ice Point created is 10).

description: This freezing sword deals winter's wrath to your enemies while protecting you from it.

name: Braver Replica

specials.name: Divine Weapon
specials.description: +2 Power, +5 Critical, +5 Accuracy, -2 Weight. Weapon durability cannot decrease.

description: A replica of a famous sword used by Ryart. It possesses extremely high power.

name: Ensui

specials.name: Protective Bubble
specials.description: Encases you in a protective bubble, reducing all damage you take by 4-7.

specials.name: Dragon Remains
specials.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

description: A sword made from the remains of a water dragon; it smashes waves against your enemies.

name: Hisen

specials.name: Fatal Stroke
specials.description: The Kensei skill Hidden Cut's effect changes in the following ways; Sheath Sword's FP cost is increased to 25 FP. Damage is increased by 25% and can critically hit. Against non-boss monsters, the damage is increased by 100% instead. If an enemy damaged by this effect is defeated by it, you regain 5 FP for each.

description: A deadly katana, which is fragile, but extremely sharp.

name: Kirosh

specials.name: Trap Immunity
specials.description: You do not trigger traps or other field hazards while moving.

specials.name: Dragon Remains
specials.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

description: A sword made from the remains of a dark dragon. Its movements cannot be traced.

name: Larveget

specials.name: Sound ATK Substitution
specials.description: Replaces your Sound ATK with the target's for 2 rounds.

specials.name: Death Ant Shriek
specials.description: Song skill. Requires Substitute Sound ATK to be active. Consumes the status caused by the weapon, deals 20 armor-ignoring Sound Kickback damage to you, and accelerates any Silence effect you're suffering from by 1 round. Additionally grants you Larveget's Cursed Wail (LV = 35% of Substituted Sound ATK, min. 5, 5 rounds). (Larveget's Cursed Wail - -10% Status Resistance. Enemies who attack you take armor-ignoring Sound magic bonus damage equal to LV and apply or power up Cursed Wound by LV (3 rounds). Triggers only once per action.)

description: A sword said to be made from the remains of an insect-god whose screams cursed all who harmed him.

name: Narcus

specials.name: Narcus Revenge
specials.description: Upon taking damage: Gain Narcus LV X (X = 50% of damage taken) for 2 rounds, which causes your next basic attack that hits to deal Fire magic bonus damage that ignores armor equal to LV. (Does not stack, but status will refresh upon taking damage if it would result in a higher LV.)

specials.name: Dragon Remains
specials.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

description: A flaming sword made from the remains of a fire dragon. It takes punishment and returns it.

name: Setsuna

specials.name: Enemy Analysis
specials.description: Shows the statistics and skills of most non-monster enemies.

specials.name: Dragon Remains
specials.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

description: A sword made from the remains of a blind dragon. Truth cannot be hidden.

name: Shine Sword

specials.name: Light Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Light bonus damage equal to 50% of your Light ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Stat Bonus
specials.description: +2 WIL, +2 FAI.

specials.name: Blessed
specials.description: Always comes enchanted with Blessed. (Against Undead, Ghost, and Possessed Enemies: Increases weapon's hit by half of your Scaled FAI.)

specials.name: Shine Knighting
specials.description: Requires a Rank D Invocation. After casting, you will temporarily change into a Shine Knight for 5 rounds. While you are a Shine Knight, you gain +5 to all stats, and access to certain new passive skills. (Shining in the Darkness: Grants the owner of this skill immunity to Dark and Light damage.) (Shining Radiance: Enemies who attack the owner of this skill are treated as if they were Blinded, potentially reducing their Hit.)

description: Radiant like a jewel... A blessed sword that shines in the holy light of Mercala.

name: Black Xyston

specials.name: Dual Weapon Type
specials.description: Also qualifies as a Polearm weapon.

description: A large, black, double-edged sword that curves near the base like an umbrella, letting it also function as a spear.

name: Rogue Dasher

specials.name: Anti-Light Armor
specials.description: Increases Scaled Weapon ATK by 20% if the target's armor type is Light Armor.

description: A sword made to dash the dastardly and not much else.

name: Salamander Sword

specials.name: Power Stacking
specials.description: Increases the Power of Salamander Sword by 5 every time you deal Fire damage, up to a maximum of +100 Power. (Lasts for the entirety of the battle. Non-monster targets only give +2 Power.)

description: Made from cooled salamander blood. This doesn't mean the sword can't get hot again, of course.

name: Sogensara

specials.name: Ice Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Ice bonus damage equal to 50% of your Ice ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Everblue
specials.description: Targets a tile up to 8 Range away that contains an enemy or plant special tile. Creates Ice Sheets in the line along from your current location to that tile, which last 3 rounds. Plant special tiles are frozen and turn into dense ice statues. If an enemy is the target and they are a Plant, they are inflicted with Frozen LV 10 for 2 rounds, but this skill enters a 3 round cooldown.

description: 3 Momentum, 10 FP An icy katana that gives nature a respite.

name: Spectre Sword

specials.name: Darkness Damage
specials.description: Deals magic Darkness bonus damage equal to 50% of your Darkness ATK, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Haunted Soul
specials.description: Always comes enchanted with Haunted Soul. (Inflicts Fear on hit for 2 rounds. -25% Status Resist.)

specials.name: Grudge
specials.description: When you are defeated by an enemy, if you are not Badly Beaten, that enemy takes 100 Akashic magic damage that ignores protection.

description: A sword possessed by a powerful spectre that has tainted it with the power of darkness.

name: Gigantys

specials.name: Weight Scaling
specials.description: Increases Weight by UL.

specials.name: Heavy Attacks
specials.description: Basic attacks cost 4M, but inflict bonus damage equal to Weight and can Guard Break.

specials.name: Dragon Remains
specials.description: Always comes made of Dragon Remains. (+3 Power, +5 Accuracy, +5 Critical, +8 Weight.)

description: Made of a large piece of bone from a long dead monster, Gigantys is large and very difficult to wield. However, for those that can manage the burden, its weight also give it extremely potent attack force.

name: Hooked Twinblade

specials.name: Pierce Bonus Damage
specials.description: Deals physical Pierce bonus damage equal to UL, which ignores armor.

specials.name: Parry Penetration
specials.description: Reduces the damage reduction of Parry skills triggered by this weapon's basic attack by UL%.

description: This almost snake-like double blade has some nasty hooks, allowing it to squirm in even through an opponent's parry.

name: Kingslayer

specials.name: Elite Slayer
specials.description: Increases the total Power of attacks and skills this weapon is used in by UL%, but only if the enemy is a Boss monster or has at least one 10* item equipped.

description: The Kingslayer is a powerful sword in its own right, but it has an almost otherworldly efficiency at killing those sitting at the top of the food chain... at least, the ones that can be killed.

name: Spine Leash

specials.name: Range Scaling
specials.description: Attack range increases by 1 for every 7 UL.

specials.name: Ice ATK Bonus
specials.description: Increases Ice ATK by UL/2. (Doesn't stack.)

specials.name: Ghostly Dog
specials.description: On Battle Start: If UL is at least 10 and fighting monsters, a ghostly dog manifests and joins your battle as an ally.

description: A bone-like whip that seems to be made from a spine of some creature, although it looks nothing like any animal you've seen. The surface of the bone seems to be covered in frost.

name: Tarnada

specials.name: Tarnada Charges
specials.description: On Critical: Gain 1+(UL/2) Tarnada Charges. Then, if you have 100 or more Tarnada Charges, consumes them and casts Vydel on the target for free.

description: Tarnada is a sword empowered by the storms of the desert on Gold. Storing that power, it will suddenly and chaotically unleash it when it decides it wants to.
